title: Three Brakes on a Strong Signal

scenes.tts: A signal this strong has to be kept off most of the time. First brake: the ligand is stored locked. T G F beta is secreted still wrapped in the front part of its precursor chain. It stays bound and covers the surfaces receptors need. It is usually tethered to the extracellular matrix. For example, a cell's integrins can pull on the wrapper, or a protease can cut it. Active ligand is released locally.
scenes.caption: A signal this strong has to be kept off most of the time. First brake: the ligand is stored locked. TGF-β is secreted still wrapped in the front part of its precursor chain. Active ligand is released locally.
scenes.visual: Cell membrane with a receptor at top, matrix bar at bottom. A yellow ligand sits inside a red wrapper tethered to the matrix, covering the receptor's surface. Integrin and protease chips (for example) act on the wrapper; the wrapper opens and the ligand rises to the receptor.

scenes.tts: Second brake: the signal makes its own inhibitor. One of the genes that Smads switch on encodes Smad seven. Smad seven binds the active type one receptor, and keeps the receptor's Smads away. That is negative feedback.
scenes.caption: Second brake: the signal makes its own inhibitor. One of the genes that Smads switch on encodes Smad7. Smad7 binds the active type I receptor, and keeps the receptor's Smads away. That is negative feedback.
scenes.visual: An R-Smad leaves the active receptor, reaches a gene that turns green, and Smad7 is made, travels back and sits on the receptor; a new R-Smad is blocked.
scenes.narration: Second brake: the signal makes its own inhibitor. One of the genes that Smads switch on encodes Smad7. Smad7 binds the active type I receptor, and keeps the receptor's Smads away. That is negative feedback.

scenes.tts: Third brake: the parts are destroyed. Smad seven brings ubiquitin ligases called Smurfs to the receptor. Smurfs tag the receptor, and some Smads, with ubiquitin for destruction.
scenes.caption: Third brake: the parts are destroyed. Smad7 brings ubiquitin ligases called Smurfs to the receptor. Smurfs tag the receptor, and some Smads, with ubiquitin for destruction.
scenes.visual: Smad7 on the receptor carries a Smurf chip; gold ubiquitin tags go from the Smurf onto the receptor and a Smad chip, which then fade away.
scenes.narration: Third brake: the parts are destroyed. Smad7 brings ubiquitin ligases called Smurfs to the receptor. Smurfs tag the receptor, and some Smads, with ubiquitin for destruction.

scenes.tts: Scott Kern's laboratory found Smad four. It is inactivated in about half of pancreatic cancers. Mice made without the myostatin gene, in Se-Jin Lee's laboratory, have muscles two to three times the normal weight. In fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva, muscle and connective tissue turn to bone. Nearly all patients with the classic form carry the same one amino acid change. It sits in the G S domain of a B M P type one receptor.
